gloss: to drive away; to push aside; to force into

definitions.gloss: to drive away; to push aside; to banish
definitions.explanation: To force someone or something out of a place, or to push a thought out of one's mind. What is moved takes を and where it goes takes に or へ: {隅|すみ}に{追|お}いやる, {頭|あたま}の{片隅|かたすみ}に{追|お}いやる.

definitions.gloss: to drive (someone) into (a bad situation); to force into
definitions.explanation: To bring someone, by pressure or circumstance, into an unwanted state such as resignation, closure or despair. The state takes に: {辞任|じにん}に{追|お}いやる. Usually said critically of the person or force responsible.

examples.english: To drive the cat out of the garden.
I pushed the old furniture into a corner of the room.

examples.english: Pushing my anxiety to the back of my mind, I concentrated on the exam.

examples.english: To force a minister to resign.

examples.english: Thoughtless words drove her into deep loneliness.

notes:
⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧ (to chase) + ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to send off). It stresses pushing something to a lesser place rather than removing it, and its second sense is figurative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{隅|すみ}→隅：01625_sumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}いやる: to push into a corner, to sideline
- ⟦{片隅|かたすみ}→片隅：13464_katasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}いやる: to push to the back (of one's mind)
- ⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}いやる: to force into resignation
- ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}いやる: to drive to death
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}いやる: to drive into a tight spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{追|お}い{払|はら}う→追い払う：06347_oiharau⟧: to chase off, to shoo away — removes something unwanted entirely
- ⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}む→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to corner, to drive into — stresses pressure up to a final point such as a deadline or defeat
